title: Central & Eastern Europe (CEE) Existing & Upcoming Data Center Report 2026: Portfolio Expands as New Developments Unlock Growth Opportunities
author: Researchandmarkets.Com
description: A comprehensive analysis of the CEE data center market reveals 290 existing facilities and 51 upcoming projects across Austria, Czech Republic, Poland, and Russia. title: Middle East & Africa (MEA) Data Center Colocation Market Poised for Strong Growth Through 2031: AI, Automation, and Digitalization Accelerate Demand

title: Digital Realty Expands Into Turkiye With Strategic Data Center JV
author: Na
description: Digital Realty has announced a strategic joint venture with Ronesans Infrastructure to enter the Turkish market. The partnership will develop a next-generation data center campus in Ankara with over 22MW of carrier-neutral IT capacity, with completion targeted for 2028. Plans also include expansion into Istanbul to create a connected regional infrastructure platform serving cloud, AI, and enterprise digital infrastructure demands.
